_help._: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is optional — anything you omit falls back to the default in bin/config.py. Priority: MEETING_ROOT / MEETING_PORT env vars > config.json > built-in defaults.
_help.port: TCP port the upload server listens on. Bound to 0.0.0.0, so keep the machine on Tailscale and off the open internet.
_help.service_label: launchd label. Also decides the plist filename: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/<service_label>.plist. Must be unique on the machine; reverse-DNS style.
_help.language: Reserved default transcription language. The per-upload form value wins.
_help.notify.mode: How this machine tells you a job moved on. 'none' (default) = no push at all; read everything at /jobs. 'telegram' = talk to the Bot API directly, no other software needed — run `python bin/notify_setup.py` to fill in the token and chat id. 'command' = shell out to a notifier you already run. 'webhook' = POST signed JSON to your own endpoint.
_help.notify.events: Which transitions are worth a push. Anything not listed is silent. Valid: transcribing, transcribed, scanning, awaiting_answers, writing, done, error.
_help.notify.telegram: bot_token from @BotFather, chat_id of the chat to post into. `python bin/notify_setup.py` discovers the chat id for you.
_help.notify.command: Command template for mode=command. {message} and {files} are substituted AFTER the template is split into argv, so a meeting title containing quotes or spaces can never become an extra argument. {files} expands to one `MEDIA:/abs/path` line per deliverable. If neither placeholder appears, the message is appended as the last argument.
_help.notify.webhook: url + secret for mode=webhook. The body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the exact bytes sent, in the X-MeetingScribe-Signature header as sha256=<hex>.
_help.branding.brand_name: Masthead text printed at the top of every generated PDF.
_help.branding.client_footer: Footer line on client-facing PDF/Word documents (--kind client).
_help.branding.participants_hint: Placeholder text in the upload form's participants field.
_help.asr.whisper_model: HuggingFace repo or local path for mlx-whisper. Downloaded on first transcription (~1.5 GB for large-v3-turbo). Use mlx-community/whisper-medium-mlx on a memory-tight machine.
_help.asr.diarization_threads: ONNX threads for speaker diarization. 4 measured faster than 10 — more threads thrash.
_help.agent.mode: What happens once the transcript exists. 'review' (default) = scan the transcript, surface the questions only you can answer at /job/<id>, and write the notes after you answer. 'auto' = scan and write back to back using every best guess, nobody in the loop. 'manual' = stop at the transcript; you press the button.
_help.agent.backend: Which CLI to drive: 'claude' (npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code) or 'codex' (npm i -g @openai/codex). It must already be logged in — an unauthenticated CLI can exit 0 having written nothing.
_help.agent.bin: Full path to that CLI. null = look it up on PATH. launchd starts with a narrow PATH, so if a job reports 'not found on PATH', put the absolute path here.
_help.agent.model: Model argument passed through to the CLI (--model / -m). null = the CLI's own default.
_help.agent.timeout_sec: Hard limit for ONE agent invocation (one chunk, or one document-writing pass). Exit code 124 in logs/<job>-agent.log means this was hit.
_help.agent.chunk_chars: Transcript slice size for the scan stage. ~14000 characters is about 20 minutes of Mandarin. A turn is never split across a boundary.
_help.agent.chunk_overlap_turns: How many turns of the previous chunk to show as read-only context, so the reader does not misjudge a sentence that starts mid-thought.
_help.agent.max_parallel: Concurrent CLI processes. Each is a full model session, so this is bounded by memory and provider rate limits, not CPU cores.
_help.agent.mapreduce_threshold_chars: Above this transcript size the meeting note is written map-reduce (extract material per chunk, then merge) instead of in one pass. Below it, one pass produces a more coherent document.
_help.agent.max_questions: Hard cap on the question cards shown to you. Eight is about two minutes of clicking; beyond that people skip the whole screen, which is worse than asking less.
_help.retention: Housekeeping hints only. Nothing is ever deleted without an explicit click — these numbers just decide what the jobs list flags as stale.
